title: Mineral Apples
description: Adds more apples to Minecraft, kinda like the golden apple.
body:
# Mineral Apples
...is a mod that adds more apples to the game, kinda like the golden apple.

This mod adds 6 apples:  
**Coal Apple** - Haste 1 for 2min and Night Vision for 3min  
**Iron Apple** - Resistance 1 for 3min and Slowness 1 for 2min  
**Diamond Apple** - Regeneration 2 for 10s, Health Boost 2 for 2min  
**Emerald Apple** - Hero of the Village for 3min, Luck 2 for 5min, Regeneration 1 for 45s  
**Netherite Apple** - Regeneration 3 for 10s, Health Boost 3 for 4min, Strength 2 for 3min  
**Quartz Apple** - Fire Resistance for 3min  

Coal Apple - good for early game mining and caving  
Iron Apple - makes you a tank at the cost of movement speed  
Emerald Apple - use before trading with villagers  
Diamond/Netherite Apple - use before a fight  
Quartz Apple - use in the Nether

# Ports
This mod will not be ported to Fabric or a newer version. Maybe. Don't count on it.  
This mod should work with Sinytra Connector.
